metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully set Chrome font size to 'Very large' via Settings > Appearance. Hardened by chaining with a second settings objective: enabling Do Not Track in Privacy and Security settings.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Chrome Settings menus and change both Appearance and Privacy settings.
metadata.explanation: Task chains two Chrome settings objectives: (1) set default font size to Very Large (24px), and (2) enable Do Not Track request. Custom getter reads Chrome Preferences file to retrieve both values. Custom metric awards 0.5 credit per objective. Both initial values differ from expected (font=16, DNT=false), ensuring negative control resistance.
metadata.task_rationale: Hardened composition: chains the proven font-size navigation with a second settings change in a different Chrome settings section (Privacy and Security), demonstrating multi-section settings mastery.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly locates Chrome Preferences file at '*/google-chrome/Default/Preferences' using a bash find command.
Getter correctly extracts font size from 'webkit.webprefs.default_font_size' — the correct JSON path in Chrome Preferences for the default font size setting.
Getter correctly extracts DNT setting from 'enable_do_not_track' — the correct key in Chrome Preferences for the Do Not Track toggle.
Expected font size value of 24 correctly corresponds to Chrome's 'Very Large' font size option.
Expected DNT value of true correctly represents the enabled Do Not Track state.
Metric covers both instruction requirements: font size (0.5) and Do Not Track (0.5), with appropriate partial credit scoring.
Error handling is robust: missing file and parse failures both return an error dict that the metric handles by returning 0.0.
Negative control resistant: initial state (font=16, DNT=false) will not pass either check.
No postconfig needed — Chrome writes Preferences to disk immediately when settings are changed via the UI.
